title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Learning Agent upskilling nudges in Microsoft Teams
notes: claim 64: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The roadmap facts and published control paths check out, including the Frontier audience choices flagged by the pre-check. The briefing correctly leaves the nudges' default and licensing unresolved, but its impact rationale should not assume that agent assignment determines who receives them; Microsoft has not documented that connection.
